about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a software engineer working at the intersection of healthcare and technology. After completing my BSc in Medical Informatics at FHNW, I'm now pursuing my Master's degree in Medical Informatics — while building real products: as a freelance fullstack developer at Swiss NTech and in web design & development at alpinelink GmbH.
about.p2: I love building software end to end: from React and TypeScript frontends to FastAPI and Spring Boot backends, all the way to Docker, cloud infrastructure and AI-powered features like RAG systems for medical documents. What drives me is turning complex medical data and processes into digital solutions people actually enjoy using.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: My Work
projects.intro: A selection of projects that show how I work: from AI-powered medical document processing to fullstack web apps and machine learning experiments. Each project links to its code repository on GitHub.

pdfrag.name: pdfRAG – Medical Document AI
pdfrag.description: Proof of concept of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for medical PDF documents: classifies clinical reports (radiology, pathology, surgery, …) with an LLM and extracts structured data via web UI and API. Built with React/TypeScript, FastAPI and Google Gemini — containerized with Docker and deployed on GCP via Terraform.

histoapp.name: HistoApp
histoapp.description: Fullstack React & Spring Boot application for viewing and annotating DICOM-based tissue images — integrated with Orthanc PACS and secured with Keycloak.

anamnese.name: Anamnesis Form – Automated PDF Analysis
anamnese.description: Automated analysis and processing of anamnesis forms, including PDF content extraction and checkbox evaluation with OCR.

region.name: Region Growing Labeling
region.description: Region-growing segmentation of star-like structures using Python, NumPy and scikit-image — with clean code and full documentation.

emotion.name: Emotion Recognition with Vision Transformer
emotion.description: Fine-tuned a Vision Transformer (ViT) for emotion classification on the FER2013 dataset — including preprocessing, augmentation and training.

parkinson.name: Parkinson Dataset Analysis
parkinson.description: Preprocessed and visualized 5,875 voice recordings from Parkinson's patients to identify predictors of UPDRS scores.

qrapp.name: QR Code Generator App
qrapp.description: Desktop application for generating and saving QR codes, supporting customization and logo embedding.
